aka.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a person standing under a low beam, legs spread wide. He just ran across a hot desert, and his face is bright <radical form="赤">red</radical>.
aka.image_prompt: A person stands under a low horizontal wooden beam, legs spread wide like the two trailing strokes at the bottom. He has just run across a hot desert. His whole sunburned face glows bright <radical>red</radical>, sweat dripping.

ame.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a window with a flat roof on top. Behind the glass, four small dashes on each side fall down. That is <radical form="雨">rain</radical>.
ame.image_prompt: A window seen from inside, with a flat roof line across the top and a frame down the middle. Behind the glass, short dashes fall on both sides of the frame, streaking down the pane. Grey sky outside. It is <radical>rain</radical>.

ana.mnemonic_text: This radical is made of <part form="宀">roof</part> and <part form="八">split</part>. The rock under a stone <part form="宀">roof</part> is <part form="八">split</part> open. Behind the gap is a dark <radical form="穴">cave</radical>.
ana.image_prompt: A rocky hillside. At the top, a flat stone ledge sticks out like a small roof. Under it, the rock splits open into two sides slanting apart, making a wide dark opening. Inside is the black mouth of a <radical>cave</radical>.

ao.mnemonic_text: This radical combines <part form="龶">sprout</part> and <part form="月">moon / month</part>. A small <part form="龶">sprout</part> climbs up, and a round <part form="月">moon / month</part> hangs below it. Both glow <radical form="青">blue-green</radical>.
ao.image_prompt: A garden trellis at twilight. A young green sprout climbs up the top of it, and a fat, round moon hangs from the vine just below. The whole scene glows in one soft color between the sky and the sea: <radical>blue-green</radical>.

ashi-foot.mnemonic_text: This radical combines <part form="口">mouth</part> and <part form="止">stop</part>. A <part form="口">mouth</part> on top shouts, "<part form="止">stop</part>!" Below it, a <radical form="足">foot</radical> stops in the middle of a step.
ashi-foot.image_prompt: A big square mouth floats at the top, shouting loudly. Below it, a leg is caught in the middle of a step, and the heel and toes press hard into the ground to freeze in place. The whole leg ends in one flat <radical>foot</radical>.

boku-divination.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like one long crack with a small crack poking out to the side. A tortoise reads these cracks on its own shell to tell the future. That is <radical form="卜">divination</radical>.
boku-divination.image_prompt: One straight crack runs down a shell, and a tiny second crack pokes out sideways halfway along it. A tortoise squints at its own back in a hand mirror, reads those two lines, and announces next week's weather by <radical>divination</radical>.

bou.mnemonic_text: This radical is one straight line from top to bottom. It looks just like a plain wooden <radical form="丨">stick</radical> standing on its end.
bou.image_prompt: A single plain wooden stick stands straight up on its end in the middle of an empty frame, perfectly vertical, with nothing else around it. It is one clean line from top to bottom: a <radical>stick</radical>.

chichi.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a man with two arms up and two legs spread wide. He stands at the barbecue, holds up the tongs, and says dinner is ready. He is <radical form="父">father</radical>.
chichi.image_prompt: A man stands over a barbecue grill. Two short strokes at the top are his raised arms, holding up tongs. Below, two long strokes cross as his legs spread wide. He smiles proudly and calls that dinner is ready. He is <radical>father</radical>.
chichi.description: 父 and 攵 both open with a short slash, but they part company underneath. 父 crosses its two lower strokes into a clear X. 攵 lays a flat horizontal bar under the slash first, and 父 has no horizontal stroke anywhere.

chikara.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a flexed arm. The long line bends like an elbow, and the short line is the bulging muscle. That arm is full of <radical form="力">power</radical>.
chikara.image_prompt: A flexed arm: the long stroke sweeps down and hooks like a bent elbow, and the short stroke is the muscle bulging out of it. The straining, hooked arm is full of <radical>power</radical>.

fudezukuri.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a hand holding a long brush. The fingers grip the top, and the long handle runs down to a soft, inky tip on the paper. It is a <radical form="聿">brush</radical>.
fudezukuri.image_prompt: A hand grips a slender upright shaft near the top, fingers clamped across it like the crossing strokes. The long straight shaft runs down through several horizontal bars and ends in a soft, ink-heavy tip pressed onto white paper. One loaded writing <radical>brush</radical>.

fuyugashira.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a foot taking a step. The heel lifts off the ground, but the sole is stuck in gum and drags behind. It is a <radical form="夂">trailing foot</radical>.
fuyugashira.image_prompt: A small tick at the top is a heel lifting off the pavement. Two strokes sweep down and across below it: the leg stretched out behind, its sole stuck in a pink wad of gum and scraping along. A <radical>trailing foot</radical>.

gonben.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a small mouth at the bottom with lines floating up above it. Each line is a sentence leaving the mouth. They are words spoken as <radical form="言">speech</radical>.
gonben.image_prompt: A small open mouth, drawn as a little box, sits at the bottom. Above it, short horizontal lines stack upward like speech bubbles floating up one on top of another, each line a sentence leaving the mouth as <radical>speech</radical>.

gyouninben.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a tall stair rail with two short steps sticking out. The rail is always on the left side of a kanji. It is the <radical form="彳">step (left)</radical>.
gyouninben.image_prompt: The long vertical stroke is a stair rail fixed down the left edge. The two short slanted strokes sticking out from it are small stair steps, worn shiny in the middle. The rail is always on the left, so every climb starts with a <radical>step (left)</radical>.
gyouninben.description: This shape only ever appears down the left-hand side of a kanji, never on the right and never on its own, which is why the meaning we teach names that position.

haba.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a hook on a wall with fabric hanging over it. The fabric falls down in two long folds. It is a piece of <radical form="巾">cloth</radical>.
haba.image_prompt: A hook nailed into a wall. Over the top bar hangs a rectangle of fabric, falling down in two long folds on each side. A straight line runs down the middle to the floor. It is a limp, hanging piece of <radical>cloth</radical>.

hachigashira.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a log split by an axe. The two strokes are the halves falling apart. The shape means split, and also <radical form="八">eight</radical>.
hachigashira.image_prompt: A single log stands on a chopping block just after an axe has come down on it. The two halves fall apart, leaning away from each other, with a clean gap at the top where the blade split them. The fresh split marks <radical>eight</radical>.
hachigashira.description: 八 and 人 are the same two falling strokes, apart or joined. 八 keeps them separate, both leaning away from a gap at the top. 人 brings them together into a single sharp peak. An open top means 八.

haha.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a woman holding two small children, one under each arm. The two dots are the children. She is <radical form="母">mother</radical>.
haha.image_prompt: A seated woman, her body a leaning frame. Two small children sit inside the frame, one under each arm, shown as two dots. A long line crosses the middle as her arms folded to hold them close. She is <radical>mother</radical>.

hi-fire.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a log standing up, with two sparks jumping off its sides. Sparks fly because the log is on <radical form="火">fire</radical>.
hi-fire.image_prompt: A single log stands upright, with two small sparks flicking off its sides near the top, one to the left and one to the right. The sparks jump into the air because the whole log is on <radical>fire</radical>.

hi-spoon.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a bent spoon. One stroke is the handle leaning left, and the other curves right into a scoop. A raccoon pushed it into hard ice cream and bent it. Now it is a bent <radical form="匕">spoon</radical>.
hi-spoon.image_prompt: A slanted handle leans down to the left, and the stroke crossing it swings right and flicks up into a little scoop. A raccoon pushed it into a tub of frozen ice cream, pulled too hard, and is now flying back, still holding the bent <radical>spoon</radical>.

hi-sun.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a tall window with one bar across the middle. Behind the glass, the sun rises to start a new <radical form="日">day</radical>.
hi-sun.image_prompt: A tall, narrow window with one bar across the middle, dividing the glass into two squares. Behind the glass, a bright blazing sun climbs up into the morning sky to start a new <radical>day</radical>.
hi-sun.description: Check the shape of the box and count what is inside it. 日 is taller than wide with one bar across the middle. 曰 has the same single bar but sits squat and wide. 目 carries two bars, 田 adds a vertical to make a full cross, and 白 is 日 with a small flick on top.

hidari.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a snake curled up tight in a box, with its head poking out of a gap at the top. You open the box, and it is already there: a <radical form="巳">snake</radical>.
hidari.image_prompt: A small open wooden box. Inside, a snake is curled up tight, its body looping around the box. Its head pokes up through a small gap at the top corner, looking at you. A calm, waiting <radical>snake</radical>.

hito.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like two legs walking: one leg stands still and the other steps forward. Two slanting lines make one walking <radical form="人">person</radical>.
hito.image_prompt: Two slanting strokes are two legs mid-stride, joined at the top: one leg planted, one swinging forward, the whole body balanced on that walking step. A single <radical>person</radical> striding across the page.
hito.description: All three are two falling strokes. 人 joins them at one clean peak. 入 slides the short stroke under the long one so the top overhangs instead of meeting. 八 never lets them touch at all.

hitoashi.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a person standing with their feet apart. The two strokes sweep down and out, like a pair of <radical form="儿">human legs</radical>.
hitoashi.image_prompt: Seen from the front, a person stands with feet planted wide apart. Only the legs are shown: two strokes sweep down and out, the left one slanting to the lower left and the right one bending out with a small upward hook, like a pair of sturdy <radical>human legs</radical>.

hitoyane.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like the lid of a pot. The small dash on top is the knob you hold. The long line under it is the flat <radical form="亠">lid</radical>.
hitoyane.image_prompt: A little cooking pot seen from the side. On top, a short dash is the tiny knob you grab, and the wide horizontal stroke beneath it is a flat disc resting over the rim. Together they sit snugly in place as the <radical>lid</radical>.

ichi.mnemonic_text: This radical is one flat line lying on the floor. One line, lying as flat as the <radical form="一">ground</radical>.
ichi.image_prompt: A single long, flat horizontal line lies straight across the floor of a plain room, perfectly level from left to right, with nothing above or below it. It is one line, lying as flat as the <radical>ground</radical>.

ireru.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a person leaning forward, one leg stepping ahead of the other, as they duck under a low doorway. They are about to <radical form="入">enter</radical>.
ireru.image_prompt: A person leans forward mid-stride, one leg swinging ahead of the other, ducking their head under a very low doorway. Their body forms the two strokes of the shape. They are just about to step inside and <radical>enter</radical>.
ireru.description: 入 and 人 use the same two strokes. In 人 they meet at the very top. In 入 the short left stroke begins partway down the long one, leaving a small overhang above it rather than a point.

ishi.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a small box under a leaning rock wall. It is a big round rock that rolled down and stopped there: one solid <radical form="石">stone</radical>.
ishi.image_prompt: A leaning rock wall on a hillside, with its top edge running flat and its left end bending down. At its base sits a boxy, rounded rock that has rolled down the slope and come to rest: one solid <radical>stone</radical>.
ishi.description: 石 and 右 both have a small box under a two-stroke top. In 石 the horizontal comes first and only its left end turns down, so nothing sticks out past the left side. In 右 the falling stroke comes first and the horizontal crosses it, so the bar sticks out on both sides.

itohen.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a small spool at the top with one strand twisting down. At the bottom, the loose ends spread out. It is one piece of <radical form="糸">thread</radical>.
itohen.image_prompt: A small wooden spool at the top. One strand winds off it and twists down in two loops. At the bottom, the end frays into three loose fibers spread apart. Plain background, one piece of <radical>thread</radical>.

itoko.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a small loop of thread with its ends hanging down. It is so thin that you have to squint to see it. It is a <radical form="幺">tiny thread</radical>.
itoko.image_prompt: A single small loop of thread pinched at the top and left dangling, its two loose ends trailing off below. It is so thin and fine that a person nearby squints hard to see this <radical>tiny thread</radical>.

iwaku.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a wide open mouth with a flat tongue across the middle. The tongue is moving, pushing out a word. The mouth is about to <radical form="曰">say</radical> something.
iwaku.image_prompt: A wide, squat open mouth seen from the front, wider than it is tall. One flat tongue lies across the middle, moving mid-word. A small speech bubble starts to come out. The mouth is about to <radical>say</radical> something.
iwaku.description: 曰 and 日 are the same box with one bar inside, told apart by proportion. 曰 is squat, wider than it is tall, and its inner bar often stops short of the right wall. 日 is clearly taller than it is wide.

juu.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like two matchsticks crossing in the middle, one flat and one standing up. They make a plus sign. This cross means <radical form="十">ten</radical>.
juu.image_prompt: Two wooden matchsticks lie on a table, one flat and one standing straight up, crossing exactly at their middles to make a perfect plus sign. Their red tips point up and to the right. The little cross stands for <radical>ten</radical>.

kai-shell.mnemonic_text: This radical combines <part form="目">eye</part> and <part form="八">eight</part>. A big clam shell with an <part form="目">eye</part> on top tips open, and <part form="八">eight</part> gold coins spill out. Long ago, shells like this were used as <radical form="貝">money</radical>.
kai-shell.image_prompt: A big clam shell with one large cartoon eye on its ridged top stands on two short legs. The shell tips open, and exactly eight shiny gold coins spill out onto the ground below. The eye looks proudly at the coins, because long ago shells were used as <radical>money</radical>.
kai-shell.description: Both stand a box on two legs, and the legs decide it. 貝 finishes with two short straight strokes dropping away like little feet. 見 finishes with a straight left leg and a right leg that curves out and hooks upward.

kakeru.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a tired person slumped sideways in a chair. His mouth is wide open in a big yawn. He does not have the energy to sit up. He shows a <radical form="欠">lack</radical> of energy.
kakeru.image_prompt: A tired person slumped sideways in a chair, the upper body leaning to one side like the top stroke, legs sprawled out below. The mouth is wide open in a huge, jaw-stretching yawn. The person is too worn out to sit up and shows a <radical>lack</radical> of energy.
kakeru.description: 欠 starts with a slash and then a short stroke that bends down like a small roof, then ends in two strokes spreading into a peak. 攵 has a straight, flat bar under its opening slash, with no bend. That bent roof versus the flat bar is the difference.

kanehen.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a little roof with two small nuggets on a stand under it. It is a safe place where you keep your <radical form="金">gold</radical>.
kanehen.image_prompt: A little pointed roof sits at the top. Under it, two tiny shining nuggets rest on a small stand, safe from the rain. It is a covered vault where someone piles up their <radical>gold</radical>.

karai.mnemonic_text: This radical is a combination of <part form="立">stand</part> and <part form="十">ten</part>. A man must <part form="立">stand</part> and eat <part form="十">ten</part> peppers on a skewer. He cries. They are <radical form="辛">spicy</radical>.
karai.image_prompt: A man in a tiny hat stands straight at a food counter. He holds one skewer with ten red peppers stacked on it. His eyes stream, and sweat lifts the hat off his head, but he says nothing here is <radical>spicy</radical>.

katana.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a curved blade that hooks at the tip. It is stuck in a frozen rice cake, and a small chip has broken off the top. One very sorry <radical form="刀">sword</radical>.
katana.image_prompt: A steel blade with a long stroke that sweeps down and hooks at the tip, standing upright with its tip stuck in a round frozen rice cake. A small chip has broken off the top left of the blade and floats beside it. It is one very embarrassed <radical>sword</radical>.

kawa.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like three long lines of water flowing down side by side. Three streams running together make a <radical form="川">river</radical>.
kawa.image_prompt: Seen from a grassy bank, three long streams of water pour down the picture side by side, the outer two bending gently with the current. The three flowing channels together form one wide <radical>river</radical>.

keigamae.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a flat roof with two tall walls and no floor. Those three sides make an open <radical form="冂">wide box</radical>.
keigamae.image_prompt: A flat roof with two tall walls dropping straight down from its ends, open at the bottom like a doorway with no floor. The three sides form the top, left and right of a <radical>wide box</radical> that is open toward the ground.
keigamae.description: Three open frames, told apart by their walls. 冂 drops two tall walls from a flat top and leaves the bottom open. 冖 has the same top but only tiny stubs instead of walls. 囗 closes the bottom as well, making a complete square.

keigashira.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a broom head turned on its side. The line on the right is where the handle goes. The three lines are the bristles. It is a <radical form="ヨ">broom</radical>.
keigashira.image_prompt: A broom head turned on its side. The upright on the right is the wooden back where the handle goes in. Three stiff grey bristle rows stick out to the left, dusty from a very long hallway. A well-used <radical>broom</radical>.

ki.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a tree. The line going down is the trunk, the flat line is a branch, and the two slanted lines are roots. It is a <radical form="木">tree</radical>.
ki.image_prompt: The vertical stroke is a tree trunk, the horizontal line is a branch spreading out to both sides, and the two slanted strokes sweep down as roots gripping the soil. It is a single <radical>tree</radical> standing in front of you.

kigamae.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like flat layers of mist lying over a hot spring. One wisp curls away to the right. All of it is <radical form="气">steam</radical>.
kigamae.image_prompt: Side view of the air above a hot spring. Flat strokes stacked at the top are layers of vapour lying over the water. The last stroke sweeps out to the right and hooks up where one wisp curls away into the cold air. All of it is <radical>steam</radical>.

ko.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a small body wrapped in a blanket, with arms thrown wide at the top. It is a <radical form="子">child</radical> running to you for a hug.
ko.image_prompt: The top stroke swings out like two little arms thrown wide, above a body wrapped snugly in a blanket that tapers to a single point below. A bundled-up <radical>child</radical>, arms open, running toward the viewer.

kokorohen.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a tall, thin candle with a tiny flame on each side. You light it when you make a wish with your whole <radical form="忄">heart (left)</radical>.
kokorohen.image_prompt: A tall, thin candle stands upright on the left side of the picture. A tiny flame flickers out on each side of the top of the wick. A person with closed eyes makes a wish in front of it, hand on chest: <radical>heart (left)</radical>.
kokorohen.description: Both are three strokes down the left edge. 忄 hangs a short dash on each side of one long vertical. 氵 has no vertical at all — just three separate slanting drops stacked downward.

kome.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like one grain in the middle with husks flying off in every direction, up and down. A farmer has just hit it hard. It is a grain of <radical form="米">rice</radical>.
kome.image_prompt: A single grain sits in the centre while its husks fly off in every direction: the top strokes spray upward, the bottom strokes kick downward. It is bursting apart the moment it is threshed. That little explosion is a grain of <radical>rice</radical>.
kome.description: 来 is 米 with one extra horizontal laid across the top. Count the horizontal strokes: 米 has one, 来 has two.

koromo.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a shirt on a hanger. The small cross on top is the hook, and the wide strokes below are the sleeves and the bottom. It is a piece of <radical form="衣">clothing</radical>.
koromo.image_prompt: A shirt hangs to dry on a clothes line. A small hanger hook sits on top, and the wide sleeves and the bottom of the shirt spread out and hang down below it. A few drops of water fall from the hem of this piece of <radical>clothing</radical>.

kougatsu.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a steel beam standing between two flat concrete slabs. Workers lower it into place at a <radical form="工">construction</radical> site.
kougatsu.image_prompt: A steel I-beam stands upright between two flat concrete slabs: the top and bottom strokes are the slabs, the line down the middle is the beam being lowered into place by a crane at a busy <radical>construction</radical> site.

kubi.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a face with two hairs on top. The face stretches up to a high shelf on a very long <radical form="首">neck</radical>.
kubi.image_prompt: Two stray hairs stick up over a flat brow, and below them a boxed-in face stretches up toward a high shelf. It is a giraffe in a business suit, and as it stretches, its shirt buttons pop off one by one down its long <radical>neck</radical>.

kuchi.mnemonic_text: This radical is a small square, like a mouth open wide in a big yawn. The four lines are the lips around the open hole. It is a <radical form="口">mouth</radical>.
kuchi.image_prompt: A small, perfect square made of four straight strokes frames a wide-open mouth caught in the middle of a big yawn. The square edges are the lips, and inside is the dark, open hole of the <radical>mouth</radical>.
kuchi.description: 口 and 囗 are drawn the same way, as a closed square. Size and job separate them: 口 stays small and stands on its own as the mouth, while 囗 is drawn large enough to wrap around other parts and always has something inside it.

kunigamae.mnemonic_text: This radical is a big closed square, like four walls with no door. You walk all the way around and find no way out. It is an <radical form="囗">enclosure</radical>.
kunigamae.image_prompt: Four solid walls form one big, unbroken square, with no door and no window. You could walk all the way around the walls and never find a way in or out. The closed square of walls is an <radical>enclosure</radical>.
kunigamae.description: 囗 is a closed square drawn big enough to surround whatever sits inside it. 冂 is the same frame with its bottom left open. 口 is the same closed square kept small, standing as a mouth rather than wrapping anything.

kuro.mnemonic_text: This radical is made of <part form="里">village</part> and <part form="灬">fire (bottom)</part>. A big <part form="灬">fire</part> burns under a small <part form="里">village</part>. The smoke turns every house <radical form="黒">black</radical>.
kuro.image_prompt: A small village of houses with fields sits in the upper part of the picture. Right below it, four big flames of a fire burn. Thick smoke rises through the village, and every house and roof is covered in soot, completely <radical>black</radical>.

kuruma.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a cart seen from above. The box is the body, the long line is the axle, and the flat bars are the wheels. It is a <radical form="車">vehicle</radical>.
kuruma.image_prompt: A wooden cart seen from directly above. A box in the middle is the body of the cart. A long line runs down through it as the axle. Horizontal bars stick out at the top and bottom as the wheels. It is a simple <radical>vehicle</radical>.

kusakanmuri.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like one flat line of soil with two small clumps poking up through it. That is a fresh patch of <radical form="艹">grass</radical>.
kusakanmuri.image_prompt: Two small clumps of green blades poke up side by side, each crossing one flat horizontal line that is the soil they sprout from. Seen from the side, it is a fresh little patch of <radical>grass</radical>.

mannaka.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a wooden shield: one long plank with two boards nailed across it. It sat in the sun so long that it is cracked and <radical form="干">dry</radical>.
mannaka.image_prompt: A wooden shield made of one long vertical plank with two crossbars nailed across it, the top one longer. It lies out in hot, bright sun until the wood is pale, cracked and completely <radical>dry</radical>.
mannaka.description: Look at the top stroke and count the bars. 干 starts with a flat horizontal and has two of them. 千 starts with a slanting flick and keeps only one bar beneath it. 牛 also starts with a flick but keeps two bars, the upper one short and pushed left.

me.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like an eye turned on its side. The box is the eyelid, and the two lines inside are the pupil. It is an <radical form="目">eye</radical> staring back at you.
me.image_prompt: An eye turned upright on its end: the tall outer box is the eyelid framing everything, and the two lines inside hold the pupil between them, staring straight back at the viewer. One vertical <radical>eye</radical>.
me.description: Count what is inside the box. 目 is tall with two horizontal bars. 日 has one. 田 has one horizontal and one vertical crossing into a full grid.

mimi.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like the side of a head. The tall frame is the outer rim, and the lines inside are the folds. It is an <radical form="耳">ear</radical>.
mimi.image_prompt: The side of someone's head: a tall outer frame is the ear's outer rim, and a stack of horizontal lines inside are the ridges and folds curving down into the canal. A whole <radical>ear</radical> stood up on the page.

miru.mnemonic_text: This radical is made of an <part form="目">eye</part> and <part form="儿">human legs</part>. A big <part form="目">eye</part> walks around your room on wobbly <part form="儿">human legs</part>. It stops to <radical form="見">see</radical> everything.
miru.image_prompt: A big round eyeball sits at the top, standing on two thin wobbly human legs. It walks across a bedroom, stops at a shelf, and leans in close to <radical>see</radical> everything on it.
miru.description: Both are a box standing on two legs. 見 ends with a straight left leg and a right leg that swings out and hooks upward. 貝 ends with two short straight strokes falling away like little feet.

mizu.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a stream falling straight down, with small splashes flying out to each side. That splash is <radical form="水">water</radical>.
mizu.image_prompt: A single stream runs straight down the middle, and two smaller trickles splash out to either side at the moment a drop hits the surface and sprays outward. The splash is frozen in mid-air: <radical>water</radical>.

mongamae.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like two tall doors standing side by side, each with a small window at the top. They creak loudly as they swing open. It is a <radical form="門">gate</radical>.
mongamae.image_prompt: Front view of two tall wooden doors standing side by side between two pillars, each door with a small square window panel at the top. Both doors are swinging open with a loud creak, showing a walled courtyard behind them. Together they form a <radical>gate</radical>.

mushi.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a fat box with a line through it and a small stroke at the corner. The box is a plump body on a pin. The stroke is a leg that still twitches. It is an <radical form="虫">insect</radical>.
mushi.image_prompt: Inside a collector's display case: a fat box-shaped body with a vertical pin through it. A small stroke sticks out from the bottom right corner, a leg still twitching. One pinned <radical>insect</radical>.

nagai.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like an old wizard with a beard. The beard flows down in many lines and piles up on the floor. It is very <radical form="長">long</radical>.
nagai.image_prompt: An old wizard stands tall. His white beard streams down from his chin in a wide fan of lines and piles up in a heap on the floor around his feet. The beard has grown for many years and is very <radical>long</radical>.

ni.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like two chopsticks lying on a table, one above the other. Two lines, two chopsticks. That is <radical form="二">two</radical>.
ni.image_prompt: Two wooden chopsticks lie flat on a table, side by side, one resting just above the other, waiting for a meal. The top one is a little shorter than the bottom one. Two lines, two chopsticks: <radical>two</radical>.

nikuduki.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a butcher's window frame. Inside it, two thick slabs hang side by side on hooks. It is the shop where the <radical form="肉">meat</radical> hangs.
nikuduki.image_prompt: A butcher shop window seen from the street, framed on three sides. Inside the frame, two thick slabs hang side by side on metal hooks from the top bar. The shop is full of hanging <radical>meat</radical>.

ninben.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a person walking, with a body and one leg stepping forward. It always stands on the left side of a kanji. It is the <radical form="亻">person (left)</radical>.
ninben.image_prompt: Two strokes lean together: a short slanted stroke is the head and body leaning forward, and a tall vertical stroke is one leg striding down. The walker is caught mid-step, pressed against the left edge of the frame: a <radical>person (left)</radical>.

onna.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a dancer with one leg crossing over the other and her arms swung wide. She is a <radical form="女">woman</radical> in the middle of her dance.
onna.image_prompt: A dancer caught mid-move: one leg swung out and crossing over the other, arms flung wide across her body. The sweeping crossed strokes are a <radical>woman</radical> frozen in the middle of her dance.

oozato.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like little bumps along a long pole on the right. The bumps are rooftops of houses. The pole is the road beside them. Houses along a road make a <radical form="阝">village</radical>.
oozato.image_prompt: On the right side, a stack of small curved rooftops, one above the other, each curving down into a long straight road that runs past them from top to bottom. It is a small <radical>village</radical> of houses along one road.

rekka.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like four small glowing coals at the bottom of a campfire. Each one has a tiny flame. It is <radical form="灬">fire (bottom)</radical>.
rekka.image_prompt: The bottom of a campfire pit at night. Four small glowing coals sit in a row, each with a tiny orange flame licking up from it. The four dots of light are the <radical>fire (bottom)</radical>.

samurai.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a man in armour. The long top line is his wide shoulders, and the short line at the bottom is his feet. He is a <radical form="士">samurai</radical>.
samurai.image_prompt: A samurai in armour seen from the front. The long top stroke is his very wide armoured shoulders, so wide they get stuck in a doorway. The vertical stroke is his straight spine, and the short line at the bottom is his two boots planted flat. He is a <radical>samurai</radical>.

san.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like three thin pancakes stacked on a plate, with a small gap between each. Count the lines: <radical form="三">three</radical>.
san.image_prompt: Three thin, flat pancakes are stacked on a plate, one above the other, with a small gap between each. The middle one is a little shorter. A hungry child with a fork counts them: <radical>three</radical>.

sanzui.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like three drops on the left side. Three little drops fall from a wet paintbrush, one after another, into a puddle of <radical form="氵">water (left)</radical>.
sanzui.image_prompt: Three small drops, stacked down the left side, flick one after another off the tip of a wet paintbrush. They fall and splash into a round puddle of <radical>water (left)</radical> below, with tiny rings on the surface.
sanzui.description: Both run three strokes down the left side. 氵 is three separate slanting drops with nothing joining them. 忄 hangs its two dashes off a single long vertical.

shimesu.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a stone table on one strong leg, with two short legs at the bottom. People put gifts on top to show them. It is an <radical form="示">altar</radical>.
shimesu.image_prompt: A stone table with a flat top rests on one strong central pillar, with two short carved legs splaying out at the base. A bowl of fruit sits on top as a gift, shown to everyone who walks by. It is an <radical>altar</radical>.

shinnyou.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a long road that sweeps out along the bottom, with two footsteps above it. You step onto the road and <radical form="辶">advance</radical>.
shinnyou.image_prompt: A long, flat road sweeps across the bottom of the scene from left to right and kicks up a little at the far end. Above the start of the road are two footprints, one after the other, as a traveller steps onto it. The traveller walks forward along the road to <radical>advance</radical>.

shiro.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a drop of milk with a small spark of light on top. The spark is the short stroke. The drop is bright, pure <radical form="白">white</radical>.
shiro.image_prompt: A single drop of milk shaped like a tall box, with a tiny slanted spark of light flicking off its top where it catches the sun. The small stroke above the box is that shine. The whole drop glows the brightest, purest <radical>white</radical>.
shiro.description: 白 is 日 with one extra stroke: a small flick sitting on top of the box. Everything below it is identical, so that little cap is the only thing to check.

shita.mnemonic_text: This radical combines <part form="千">thousand</part> and <part form="口">mouth</part>. A wide open <part form="口">mouth</part> sits below a tower of a <part form="千">thousand</part> ice cream scoops. A long pink <radical form="舌">tongue</radical> reaches up to lick them all.
shita.image_prompt: A huge, wide open mouth at the bottom of the scene. Above it rises a very tall, wobbly tower of a thousand colourful ice cream scoops. A long pink <radical>tongue</radical> stretches up out of the mouth and licks the whole tower, stripe by stripe. Flat cartoon style.

shou.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like one tiny seed in the middle, with a hand pinching in from each side. The hands show how <radical form="小">small</radical> it is.
shou.image_prompt: A single tiny seed sits in the centre as a short vertical stroke. Two little hands pinch in toward it from the left and the right, fingers almost touching, showing off just how <radical>small</radical> it is.

sun.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a flat wooden ruler with one small tick mark on it. A thumb holds the ruler down to measure exactly one <radical form="寸">inch</radical>.
sun.image_prompt: A carpenter's flat wooden ruler lies across the top, with a hooked upright hanging from it and one small tick mark beside the upright. A thumb presses on the tick mark to pin the ruler in place and measure exactly one <radical>inch</radical>.
sun.description: Both have a hooked vertical crossed by a bar. 寸 adds a single dot beside the vertical, on its left. 扌 has no dot; its last stroke is a flick rising from the lower left up through the vertical.

ta.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a field seen from above. Two paths cross in the middle and cut it into four squares. Those green squares are a <radical form="田">rice field</radical>.
ta.image_prompt: Seen from above, a big square of farmland. Two narrow dirt paths cross in the middle, cutting it into four neat green squares of flooded young rice. A farmer stands at the edge of the <radical>rice field</radical>.
ta.description: 田 is the only one of the three with a vertical inside the box, splitting it into four. 日 has a single horizontal bar and 目 has two, but neither is ever divided down the middle.

takai.mnemonic_text: This radical combines <part form="亠">lid</part>, <part form="口">mouth</part> and <part form="冋">prairie</part>. A tower stands on a wide <part form="冋">prairie</part>. It has a <part form="亠">lid</part> for a roof and a window shaped like a <part form="口">mouth</part>. It is very <radical form="高">tall</radical>.
takai.image_prompt: A slender tower stands alone on a wide, flat prairie of grass. A pointed lid sits on top as its roof. Just below the roof is one square window shaped like an open mouth. Wider rooms stack below it, and the tower rises into the clouds, very <radical>tall</radical>.

takekanmuri.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like two tall green stalks side by side. Each stalk has one leaf sticking out. Two stalks with leaves are <radical form="竹">bamboo</radical>.
takekanmuri.image_prompt: Two straight green stalks stand side by side, each split into segments by rings. The left stalk has one leaf pointing out to the left, and the right stalk has one leaf pointing out to the right. The two stalks are <radical>bamboo</radical>.

tatsu.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a person on a wide flat floor. The dot is the head, the two short lines are arms out for balance, and the long line is the ground. They <radical form="立">stand</radical> tall.
tatsu.image_prompt: A simple figure on a wide flat platform. The top dot is the head, two short slanted strokes below it are arms thrown out for balance, and the long bottom line is the solid ground under their feet. The figure is upright and steady, ready to <radical>stand</radical>.

te.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like an open hand. The long line runs up from the wrist through the palm. The three flat lines are spread fingers. It is a <radical form="手">hand</radical>.
te.image_prompt: A wrist at the bottom with one long vertical stroke running up through the palm, while three horizontal strokes fan out sideways like fingers spread wide. We look straight at an open <radical>hand</radical>.

tehen.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like an arm with three short fingers sticking out to the side. It sits on the left of a kanji and grabs what is next to it. It is a <radical form="扌">hand (left)</radical>.
tehen.image_prompt: A vertical arm with a hook at the bottom stands at the left edge. Three short strokes branch off to the side like a thumb and fingers curling out, reaching right to grab whatever comes next. It is a <radical>hand (left)</radical>.
tehen.description: Both are built on a hooked vertical. 扌 ends with a flick rising from the lower left into that vertical and never carries a dot. 寸 is the reverse: no rising flick, one clear dot set to the right of the hook.

ten.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like one tiny slanted mark. It is a single bead of water, sliding off the tip of a leaf. That one little stroke is a <radical form="丶">drop</radical>.
ten.image_prompt: A single small bead of water hangs in the air, caught the moment it slides off the pointed tip of a green leaf. It is slanted a little as it falls, one clear <radical>drop</radical>.

tomeru.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a foot planted flat on the ground, with the heel and toes dug in. The foot will not take one more step. It has come to a <radical form="止">stop</radical>.
tomeru.image_prompt: A single cartoon foot planted flat on the ground, seen from the side. The long bottom stroke is the flat sole; the tall upright and the short side stem stick up like the heel and toes, dug firmly into the ground. The foot is frozen mid-stride and will not move: a full <radical>stop</radical>.

tsuchi.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a wooden signpost stuck in the ground. The long line at the bottom is the flat ground it stands in. That ground is <radical form="土">earth</radical>.
tsuchi.image_prompt: A wooden signpost is hammered into the ground, its post crossed by one short board. The long horizontal line at the bottom is the flat ground it is planted in. The post stands in the soil, marking a patch of <radical>earth</radical>.

tsuki.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a tall window with two bars across it. At night you press your face to the glass and see the <radical form="月">moon</radical>.
tsuki.image_prompt: A tall, narrow window with two bars across the middle. It is night. A person presses their face to the glass, and framed perfectly inside the window hangs a bright crescent <radical>moon</radical>.

ukanmuri.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a dot on top of a wide line with sides that slope down. The dot is a chimney. A pigeon slides down the slope of the <radical form="宀">roof</radical>.
ukanmuri.image_prompt: A single dot on top is a chimney. Below it, a flat line spreads wide with both edges dropping down as eaves. A pigeon has landed on the chimney, lost its balance, and is sliding on its belly down the slope of the <radical>roof</radical>.

uma.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like an animal seen from the side. The box on top is the head and body, and the four dots below are legs running fast. It is a <radical form="馬">horse</radical>.
uma.image_prompt: An animal seen from the side, drawn with boxy shapes. The block at the top is the head and mane, and the body sits below it. Four little legs dash along the bottom, kicking up dust as it gallops. It is a <radical>horse</radical>.

ushi.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like an animal seen from the front. The slanted top stroke is one horn, and the two bars below are its shoulders and back. It is a <radical form="牛">cow</radical>.
ushi.image_prompt: An animal seen from the front. A slanted stroke on top is a single horn tilting on its head. Two horizontal bars below are its strong shoulders and back, with a vertical line through the middle as its body. It is a <radical>cow</radical>.
ushi.description: All three are bars crossed by a vertical. 干 starts flat, with no slash on top. 牛 and 午 both start with a slanting flick, but 牛's vertical pushes up above the upper bar while 午's stops at it.

yamahen.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like three peaks rising from flat ground. The tall peak in the middle is the top of a <radical form="山">mountain</radical>.
yamahen.image_prompt: Three peaks rise from one flat ground line: a tall peak in the middle with a shorter peak on each side. Seen straight on, together they form the jagged outline of a <radical>mountain</radical> against a clear blue sky.

yumi.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a strip of wood that bends back and forth. Tie a string from top to bottom, pull it tight, and you are holding a <radical form="弓">bow</radical>.
yumi.image_prompt: A strip of springy wood bends back and forth in stacked curves, seen from the side, with a notch at the top and bottom where the string hooks on. A tight string runs between the notches. It is a <radical>bow</radical>.

yuu-evening.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a thin crescent moon with a small cloud passing across it. When the moon comes out, it is <radical form="夕">evening</radical>.
yuu-evening.image_prompt: A curve leans in from the top and folds back like a thin crescent moon, and one short stroke slips through the middle like a drifting cloud. A hedgehog on a balcony holds a fork up to the moon, sure someone takes a bite of it every <radical>evening</radical>.
